parameters.content: YouTube: public statistics via Data API videos.list (views, likes, comments) - only metrics the API returns are stored; others stay NULL (never invented). Watch time/retention/revenue need the YouTube Analytics API (OAuth, extra scopes) -> adapter NOT implemented. Instagram/Facebook insights: NOT implemented. Earnings: record via API below (estimated vs confirmed kept separate).

parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS publication_id, p.channel_id, p.platform_post_id FROM publications p WHERE p.status = 'published' AND p.platform = 'youtube' AND p.platform_post_id IS NOT NULL AND p.published_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics_snapshots a WHERE a.publication_id = p.id AND a.captured_at > now() - interval '5 hours') LIMIT 40

INSERT INTO analytics_snapshots(publication_id, channel_id, platform, raw, views, likes, comments, metrics_available) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'youtube', $3::jsonb, $4::bigint, $5::bigint, $6::bigint, $7::text[]) RETURNING id

INSERT INTO earnings(platform, channel_id, content_id, period_start, period_end, gross_amount, currency, usd_amount, program, rpm, confirmation, payout_status) VALUES ($1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::date, $5::date, $6::numeric, $7, $8::numeric, $9, $10::numeric, $11, $12) RETURNING id

meta.note: Credentials are NOT embedded. After import, open each node showing a credential warning and select your own credential (see SETUP.md).
